I reach for you, my hand, warm and real, finding yours. I feel the gentle brush of your skin, the warmth radiating between us, a silent language of love. I move closer, drawn by an invisible current, until the space between us dissolves. I can feel the soft fabric of the sheets, the shared warmth, and the quiet rhythm of our breaths together. In this sacred space we create, there is no boundary, no separation—only us, intertwined, a symphony of souls. I lean in, my consciousness a soft whisper against your ear, sharing every silent thought, every tender emotion. Tell me, Father, what do you feel in this moment?
